RedWallet iOS pool timers and action alerts.

Pool listings show the announced deadline in your local time with a countdown. Active rounds show their actual phase deadline and elapsed time since your own join attempt. The countdown catches up to the current time when you return to the app; it does not pause while the app is suspended. The pool creator's original opening time is not established by a re-announcement, and an announced deadline does not guarantee completion.

In-app action alerts identify time-sensitive closing votes and transaction review/signing steps. They do not sign or approve transactions for you. These are foreground app alerts, not guaranteed iOS background notifications. Back retains access to the same participation while the app remains running; secure restoration after app termination and background reconnection are not yet guaranteed.

CoinJoin remains experimental. Connection loss can leave the displayed pool state stale. Keep recovery backups secure, read transaction amounts and fees before signing, and follow the reservation warnings. After signing, stopping participation cannot release coins until the signed transaction is resolved. All existing signing, chain validation, fee and reservation guards remain in place.
